rate_plans_validity_ordered.name: rate_plans_validity_ordered
rate_plans_validity_ordered.value: "rate_plans"."valid_to" is null or "rate_plans"."valid_from" is null or "rate_plans"."valid_to" >= "rate_plans"."valid_from"

mail_items_status_consistent.name: mail_items_status_consistent
mail_items_status_consistent.value:
case "mail_items"."status"
        when 'received' then "mail_items"."opening_requested_at" is null and "mail_items"."opened_at" is null
        when 'opening_requested' then "mail_items"."opening_requested_at" is not null and "mail_items"."opened_at" is null
        when 'opened' then "mail_items"."opened_at" is not null
        else false
      end

mail_scan_views_viewer_consistent.name: mail_scan_views_viewer_consistent
mail_scan_views_viewer_consistent.value:
case "mail_scan_views"."viewer"
        when 'staff' then "mail_scan_views"."staff_member_id" is not null and "mail_scan_views"."client_member_id" is null
        when 'client' then "mail_scan_views"."client_member_id" is not null and "mail_scan_views"."staff_member_id" is null
        else false
      end

mail_scans_unencrypted_idx.name: mail_scans_unencrypted_idx
